title: Measure the hosted fixed-budget Uniform crossover
question: Can more retained capacity avoid the OPFS spill within an unchanged 1024 MiB Run request?
summary: The broad 384 MiB target saves 7.664–7.941 seconds in three matched browser pairs. A separate native Fisher–Yates control crosses capacity between 8 and 12 MiB retained at the same 32 MiB job.

workloads: 800,000-row standalone hosted Uniform at 1024 MiB, one worker, 4 MiB cap.
72 wide-row explicit native Fisher–Yates at 32 MiB under 16 MiB and 8 MiB shared ceilings.

validation.summary: Every successful output verifies IDs, fields, caps and manifest. Native capacity denials and hosted success clean up. Browser also verifies markers.

limitations: The browser time applies to one mode, fixture and bundled browser. Fisher–Yates capacity has no matched elapsed time.
exclusions: Default promotion of the broad random-sort target, platform generalization and physical I/O or RSS claims.
reopen_when: Evaluate a bounded leading-sorter guard and actual pressure before promoting any path.
